title: eugenia cordata
intro: Eugenia cordata, commonly known as the Cordia Tree or Wild Plum, is a plant species belonging to the family Ebenaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, thereby providing relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in Eugenia cordata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's extracts have been used to treat various health conditions, making it a significant source of natural medicine.
